name: The Vast White
description:
About This Game

A SMALL RESORT. A VAST MOUNTAIN.

In The Vast White, you play as a little mouse who arrives at an old, nearly forgotten ski resort.

Freely explore its slopes on your snowboard, meet the locals who call the mountain home, and help them get the resort running again. Little by little, your actions will bring it back to life and uncover the stories hidden beneath the snow.

EXPLORE AT YOUR OWN PACE

Ride down sweeping slopes, make your way through snowy forests, and discover frozen lakes, hidden valleys, and trails far from the main routes.

There is no single way to explore the mountain. Choose your own path, search for secret spots, or simply enjoy the ride and the scenery.

MEET THE MOUNTAIN’S INHABITANTS

The resort may look abandoned, but it is far from empty.

Meet its quirky inhabitants, listen to their stories, and help them through a variety of small quests. Every character has their own story, memories, and reasons for staying.

BRING THE RESORT BACK TO LIFE

Your actions will help the resort open its doors to the public once again. With every task you complete, new paths, activities, and corners of the mountain will open up for you to explore.

A PEACEFUL ADVENTURE IN THE SNOW

The Vast White blends exploration, snowboarding, and storytelling into a relaxing experience you can enjoy at your own pace.

You do not need to be the first to arrive or find the perfect run. Sometimes, the best path is the one you take without worrying about when you will get there.
short_desc: A snowy mountain, the stillness, and you. With the help of your snowboard, rediscover the memories buried in the snow. Meet the locals, explore every path, and bring the ski resort back to life.
